commands.name: open-resume
commands.title: Open Resume
commands.description: Open a resume by providing a JSON resume URL

commands.name: create-resume
commands.title: Create Resume
commands.description: Create and save a JSON Resume inside the extension

tools.name: text-to-resume
tools.title: Convert Text to JSON Resume
tools.description: Validates and formats JSON Resume data extracted from user-provided text. Returns JSON; optionally saves a new file at an explicitly requested path.

tools.name: list-resumes
tools.title: List Saved Resumes
tools.description: List or search local saved resume summaries and IDs. Does not fetch URL bookmarks.

tools.name: get-resume
tools.title: Get Saved Resume
tools.description: Read a complete local resume by its stable ID before viewing or editing it.

tools.name: save-resume
tools.title: Save Resume
tools.description: Save complete JSON Resume data as a new local document inside the extension.

tools.name: update-resume
tools.title: Update Saved Resume
tools.description: Replace JSON and title of an existing local resume by ID. Read it first and preserve unrelated fields.

tools.name: delete-resume
tools.title: Delete Saved Resume
tools.description: Delete the local resume the user explicitly identified by its stable ID.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
